newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO HIT BY STOMACH BUG ON EVE OF CUP-TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO HIT BY STOMACH BUG ON EVE OF CUP-TIE.

text.p: Ten Atletico Madrid players are still recovering from a stomach bug on the eve of the Spanish Cup holders' fourth-round tie with Compostela.
Atletico had to pull out of their league game over the weekend and will be struggling to put together a side for the match, one of four all-first division clashes scheduled for Wednesday.
The highlight of the round, Barcelona v Real Madrid, has been put back to Thursday.
Atletico authorities have been reluctant to ask for another postponement because of a hectic fixture list including league, cup and European Cup commitments.

The Atletico players affected by the bout of gastro-entiritis have lost an average of two kilos each ahead of the tie, in which they are due to confront former team mate Lyuboslav Penev, the Bulgarian striker who moved to Compostela in the close season.
Topping the bill among other matches is Tenerife's game with Real Betis, who are third in the league.
Bottom-placed Extremadura hope to continue their run of back-to-back league wins in the game at Rayo Vallecano, the Madrid-based side whose greatest ally is their treacherous pitch.
There is the prospect of an intriguing duel when Angel Cappa, manager of second division Las Palmas, faces up to Valencia's Jorge Valdano.
The two Argentines worked side by side at Tenerife and Real Madrid until Valdano's dismissal from the latter club last January.
Spanish Cup, fourth round first leg (kick-off times GMT):

Wednesday Tenerife v Betis 17.30, Las Palmas v Valencia 20.00, Lleida v Celta Vigo 20.00, Atletico Madrid v Compostela 20.00, Rayo Vallecano v Extremadura 20.00, Racing Santander v Athletic Bilbao 20.00
